                                                                                            function LockTween()
                                                                                                if not _G.LockTween then
                                                                                                    do return end

                                                                                                end

                                                                                                wait()
                                                                                                Character54 = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("BodyClip")
